source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed brake tests in a vehicle inspection report

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Select “Add new inspection”
3. Enter in the required details for the vehicle (Driver, License Plate Number, VIN, Inspection Interval & Odometer reading)
4. Go to the “Inspection” tab and edit and fill in all items (including “Front Brake Failure” items).
5. Save and repeat steps 1-4 until all failing brake tests are saved in a new record.
6. Navigate to “Record” tab
7. Select “No Defects”, the inspection record you have just created.
8. Enter in the required information in the first two boxes (when “When did the driver know about the failure?” and “Explain what happened that caused the problem”).
9. Review and make sure the inspection items that are not failing match the vehicles condition.
10. Review and make sure you entered the odometer reading again, which should match the correct odometer at time of repair (usually, but not always
